------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                        Carolina in My Mind – James Taylor
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Standard tuning
In the key of F (D relative to capo)
Capo on 3
Tabbed by Robert Saunders

[Chords]

D:        XX0232
G5/F#:    2X0033
Em7:      020030 (or 022030. In the intro play: 0X0033)
Gsus2/A:  X00033 (also Dsus4/A)
G:        320033 (JT nearly always plays it with 3rd fret second string)
A:        X02220
D/C#:     X40232
Em7/B:    X2003X
A7sus4:   X0203X
Cadd9:    X32030
Bm:       X24432 (or play Bm7: X24232)
Bm7:      X2023X
E7sus4/B: X20200 (or X20230)
F#m:      244222
G/B:      X20003
Em9:      0X4035
[ch]A7[/ch]*:      X00035

[Notes]

James Taylor plays this song a bit differently every time. This tab is transcibed from the way
he plays it in the tutorial on his website: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=J8-5czYJvPM

I’ve not included James Taylor’s trademark embellishments on the A chords but they are all based
around A(X02220) Asus2(X02200) Asus4(X02230) A7(X0202) A7sus2(X0200)and A7sus4(X02030).

To keep the tab easy to read, I’ve not added all the walk-up and -downs but here is the tab for
the walk up in the second line of verse 3:

B|-0------2------3------0-----|-2------3-------------------|-----|
G|-0------0------0------0-----|-2------2-------------------|-----|
D|----------------------------|----------------------------|-----|
A|--------0------2------------|-0------0-------------1-----|-2---|
E|-3--------------------3-----|----------------------------|-----|[/tab]
